_info: Act 1 of the run. Map: floors floors, width_min–width_max nodes on each, the boss at the top. Node type: bitva (battle), elita (elite), udalost (event), tabor (camp) (the boss is always at the top). first_floor/last_floor = type of the whole floor (first floor all battles, the last before the boss a camp). weights = type weights on the other floors, elite_from = lowest floor with an elite. battles/elites = scenario keys (taken in turn from a shuffled list), boss = boss scenario, events = keys from udalosti.json. regen = how much health (share) a hero heals on his own after a battle, camp_heal = how much the camp heals. Elite: elite_offers offers, elite_picks picks. max_calm = at most this many nodes without a fight (event, camp) in a row on a path; the generator also never puts the same non-battle type twice in a row and makes every fork offer different types (smart shuffle, 07.11.2026). offer_oaths = how many of the offers after a battle are oaths, elite_ability_offers = how many elite offers are a new ability (swap), decline_glory = glory for declining the reward. camp = camp choices (one per camp): rest (heal), train (a passive from choices for a chosen hero), rite (an oath from choices, or release an oath), feast (cost glory: heal everyone, a chosen pair +wins shared victories); needs = what the player picks (hero / pair).
name: The Count's Forest

rest.name: Rest
rest.desc: All heroes heal to full health.

train.name: Training
train.desc: One hero learns a passive: choose from 3 made for him.

rite.name: Rite
rite.desc: One hero swears an oath (choose from 2), or is released from his oath without shame.

feast.name: Feast
feast.desc: Everyone heals 50 % and a chosen pair gains a shared victory.
